description: Fix a bug where HTML and JSON recipe imports are failing due to missing asynchronous handling. The issue causes scraping operations to terminate prematurely before completion, and there's an associated UI bug that needs to be addressed. Ensure the import process completes successfully before proceeding.
functional_requirements: Add proper await handling for scraping operations to prevent premature termination
Fix the associated UI bug that occurs during the import failure scenario
Ensure HTML and JSON imports complete fully before the process continues
Maintain existing functionality for all other import methods
